title: Maddrey's Discriminant Function
sources: Carithers RL et al. Ann Intern Med 1989
purpose: Determines whether severe alcoholic hepatitis warrants corticosteroid therapy. DF ≥ 32 = severe.

interpretation.label: < 32 — not severe by mDF
interpretation.detail: Corticosteroids generally not indicated; supportive care, nutrition, alcohol cessation. Consider MELD as an alternative severity index.

interpretation.label: ≥ 32 — severe alcoholic hepatitis
interpretation.disposition: Consider prednisolone 40 mg/day if no contraindication (active GI bleed, uncontrolled sepsis, HBV, AKI); reassess response with the Lille score at day 7

notes: Use the same units (seconds) for both PT values. If only INR is available, mDF is less reliable — MELD or MELD-Na is the better severity tool in that case.
